critical_code_review_comments: StandardOutputFormatter class in standardized_models.py correctly implemented
All 4 engines use get_formatter() to produce uniform output
Metadata includes all required fields: engine_name, engine_version, analysis_id, confidence, confidence_level, analyzed_at, data_source, data_source_type, from_cache
overall_score follows standard structure: score (0-100), level (enum), components (dict), interpretation (string)
Score level mapping is consistent: exceptional (90+), excellent (80-89), good (60-79), moderate (40-59), low (20-39), poor (0-19)
Cache functionality working correctly with from_cache flag in metadata
